termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully. TechyComm is an open source platform provided 'as is' with strict limitations of liability under EU and Spanish laws.

identification.title: 1. Open Source Project & Platform Operator
identification.content: TechyComm is an open-source educational and technical blogging platform maintained by the TechyComm open-source community, based in Spain. Official inquiries can be directed to me@davidfrancisco.dev.

acceptance.title: 2. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing TechyComm, using its source code, creating an account, or reading its content, you agree to these Terms of Service, operating under the laws of Spain and the European Union. If you do not agree, you must cease using the platform.

openSourceDisclaimer.title: 3. Open Source 'AS IS' Disclaimer & No Warranty
openSourceDisclaimer.content: TechyComm and all associated source code, articles, code snippets, and tools are provided strictly 'AS IS' and 'AS AVAILABLE', without warranty of any kind, express or implied (including warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy, or uptime). You execute any code snippets or tutorials at your own risk.

account.title: 4. User Accounts & Responsibilities
account.content: Users are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials and for all actions conducted through their accounts. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized access.

intellectualProperty.title: 5. Intellectual Property & Open Source Licensing
intellectualProperty.content: TechyComm's underlying software is released as open source. Articles, posts, and user contributions belong to their respective authors, who grant TechyComm a non-exclusive license to host and display the content.

acceptableUse.title: 6. Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUse.content: Users must not engage in unlawful acts, deploy malicious software, attempt unauthorized system access, post spam/hate speech, or breach EU/Spanish legislation.

hostingSafeHarbor.title: 7. User Content & Intermediary Liability (DSA / LSSI-CE Safe Harbor)
hostingSafeHarbor.content: Pursuant to the EU Digital Services Act (DSA) and Spanish LSSI-CE (Article 16), TechyComm acts as an intermediary hosting provider. The TechyComm project maintainers do not pre-screen or assume liability for user-generated comments or third-party links, but will act promptly upon receiving valid notice of illegal content.

liability.title: 8. Maximum Limitation of Liability
liability.content: To the fullest extent permitted by Spanish and European Union law, the TechyComm project maintainers and contributors shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, special, or punitive damages (including loss of data, system disruption, or lost profits) arising out of or related to your use of TechyComm. If any liability cannot be excluded under mandatory EU consumer protection laws, total liability is capped at 0€.

indemnification.title: 9. User Indemnification
indemnification.content: You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the TechyComm project maintainers and contributors from any third-party claims, liabilities, damages, or costs resulting from your breach of these Terms or misuse of the platform.

governingLaw.title: 10. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
governingLaw.content: These Terms are governed exclusively by the laws of Spain and European Union regulations. Any disputes shall be submitted to the competent courts of Spain.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.content: For inquiries regarding these Terms, contact the TechyComm team at me@davidfrancisco.dev.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: Your privacy is paramount. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in compliance with GDPR.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller Identification
controller.content: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR - EU 2016/679) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), the data controller responsible for processing your personal information is the TechyComm Project (TechyComm Open Source Community), based in Spain.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect information you provide directly (such as name, username, email address, profile details, and user comments), as well as automated usage data (IP address, browser parameters, pages viewed, and session tokens) required for authentication and platform functionality.

legalBasis.title: 3. Purpose & Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: We process your personal data based on: (a) Performance of a contract: managing your account and service functionality; (b) Legitimate interest: platform security, fraud prevention, and system maintenance; (c) Consent: optional communications or cookies.

retention.title: 4. Data Storage & Retention
retention.content: Your data is stored securely using industry-standard encryption. We retain your personal information only as long as your account remains active or as required by law to fulfill tax or legal obligations in Spain.

rights.title: 5. Your Data Protection Rights (GDPR / LOPDGDD)
rights.content: Under European data protection laws, you have the right to access, rectify, delete (right to be forgotten), restrict processing, request data portability, and object to processing. You can exercise these rights anytime by contacting me@davidfrancisco.dev. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD - www.aepd.es).

thirdParties.title: 6. Third-Party Services & Integrations
thirdParties.content: We may use trusted third-party service providers (such as GitHub & Google OAuth for authentication, and secure cloud storage) who adhere to strict GDPR compliance standards and data processing agreements.

cookies.title: 7. Cookie Policy
cookies.content: TechyComm uses essential session cookies to keep you signed in and save your UI theme/language preferences. We do not sell your personal data or track you across third-party websites.

contact.title: 8. Privacy Inquiries
contact.content: For any privacy-related questions or data protection requests, please email the TechyComm privacy team at me@davidfrancisco.dev.

aboutPage.title: About TechyComm
aboutPage.subtitle: An Open Source technical blogging platform built for developers, engineers, and tech enthusiasts.
aboutPage.creatorBio: TechyComm is an open-source software project created and maintained by a passionate community of software developers in Spain and around the world, dedicated to modern web engineering, clean code, and open knowledge sharing.
aboutPage.openSourceDescription: TechyComm is built in the open. The source code is publicly accessible, allowing developers worldwide to inspect, learn, contribute, and collaborate transparently.
aboutPage.missionDescription: TechyComm bridges technical writing with an interactive developer community. We believe in high-quality technical content, open knowledge, and fostering an inclusive open-source ecosystem.

quality.title: Technical Excellence
quality.description: Deep-dive articles, practical code walkthroughs, and real-world software architecture insights.

community.title: Open Source & Community
community.description: Transparent codebase, open community participation, and collaborative technical growth.

performance.title: Modern & Performant
performance.description: Built with cutting-edge web tech to ensure lightning-fast page speed, accessibility, and multi-language support.

aboutPage.contactDescription: Have questions, feedback, or want to contribute to the open-source codebase? Reach out to the TechyComm team.
